$comment: GUTTERCAPS — vertical social frames (9:16, 1080×1920). One entry per short/reel cover. Lore anchors come from packages/economy/src/lore.ts, the palette and the chip-face rules from docs/07-art-spec.md and client theme.css. `hook` text is what the editor burns in on top of the frame (never baked into the art).

palette.banned: #2E8BFF (trust-blue — money UI only, never in art)

safe_zones.middle: 430–1330 px — subject, must read in a 1-second swipe
safe_zones.bottom: 1330–1920 px darkened — caption/subtitle UI + the platform's own controls

rules: No readable text, letters or numbers inside the artwork (localizing 7 languages + no drift from lore).
Every cap face mirrors the district chip art (moth / BMX / freight car / sneaker seam / boombox / raccoons / neon door / holo city).
Rim material follows the tier ladder: scratched zinc → wet zinc → steel → oil-slick → magenta enamel → crackle orange → bronze → glowing bronze → prism/holo.
No real brands, no celebrity likenesses, no coins/banknotes, no swooshes.

frames.lore_anchor: The anonymous stencil painter who reappears every new moon; the Keepers photograph each piece and find a single bottle cap at its base — the first charged chip (04-5 tier-line starts at 'Quick Moth').

hook.ru: On every new moon, the city wakes up to a new moth.
hook.en: Every new moon, the city wakes up to a new moth.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — rain on a dead-end street, moth stencil half-washed by a second storm, drips running down the metal
2.5–6.0 s — slow push-in: the cap in the gutter, rim bites the lamp light, the puddle mirrors the piece
6.0–9.0 s — hold on the cap face, hook text burns in: «Every drain holds a charge»
frames.sfx: rain loop, distant transformer hum, one spray-can hiss on the cut
frames.caption_ru: Каждое новолуние город просыпается с новой бабочкой на стене. Кто-то оставляет рядом одну крышку — первую «заряженную» фишку города. Район 01 · Ночной Мотылёк.
frames.caption_en: Every new moon the city wakes up to a new moth — and one bottle cap left at the base. District 01 · Night Moth.

frames.lore_anchor: A drought emptied the public pools, bored teens turned the bowls into an unlicensed skate park; the pools are gone, the caps carrying each trick's name are still the district's currency.

hook.ru: They drained the pools. We kept the coping.
hook.en: They drained the pools. We kept the coping.

beats: 0.0–2.0 s — rain over the empty bowl, sodium lights, the fence with torn mesh
2.0–5.5 s — the rider clears the fence in slow-motion, droplets freeze around the tyres
5.5–9.0 s — land, the debris settles, the cap rests on the wet coping with a magenta rim glow
frames.sfx: freehub clicks, tyres on wet concrete, crowd whoop on the landing, then rain
frames.caption_ru: Когда-то тут был городской бассейн. Теперь это чаша для тех, кто прыгает через забор — и фишки, названные их трюками. Район 02 · Асфальтовые Дьяволы.
frames.caption_en: It used to be a public pool. Now the coping belongs to whoever clears the fence. District 02 · Asphalt Devils.

frames.lore_anchor: Crews fight for a car, not a wall — a whole train carries the name into cities the crew will never visit; the sighting log lives on-chain and can't be edited after the fact.

hook.ru: A piece only counts when the car leaves the city.
hook.en: A piece only counts when the car leaves the city.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — fog, empty rails converging, one floodlight halo, red signal
2.5–6.0 s — tilt down the fresh magenta throw-up on the boxcar, wet and glossy
6.0–9.0 s — the cap on the ballast, approaching train glow in the fog, hook text
frames.sfx: far-off horn, rail joint clack, gravel crunch, spray hiss on the drop
frames.caption_ru: Здесь дерутся не за стену, а за вагон: имя уезжает в города, где тебя никогда не будет. Журнал наблюдений теперь нельзя отредактировать. Район 03 · Короли Рельсов.
frames.caption_en: They fight for a car, not a wall — the name rides into cities the crew will never see. District 03 · Rail Kings.

frames.lore_anchor: Every flood season drowns half the flea market under the overpass; divers fish waterlogged pairs out of the drain and Rusty Stitch revives them with a signature thread colour. Fakes are why provenance matters most here.

hook.ru: Half the market is underwater. The other half is worth saving.
hook.en: Half the market is underwater. The other half is worth saving.

beats: 0.0–2.0 s — water sheeting off the girders, flooded stalls, lamps on the expressway reflected in the water
2.0–5.5 s — the cobbler's bench: clamp, awls, the second thread pulled through the seam
5.5–9.0 s — cap on the bench, orange crackle rim, hook text over the dark top
frames.sfx: pouring rain, water slap under the tyres of passing cars, thread pull, lantern hiss
frames.caption_ru: Каждый паводок топит половину рынка — а «Ржавый стежок» возвращает пары к жизни своей ниткой. Фейки здесь не переживают проверку. Район 04 · Подошвы из Ливнёвки.
frames.caption_en: Every flood drowns half the market. Rusty Stitch pulls it back with one signature thread. District 04 · Gutter Soles.
frames.status: regen-queued — raw output had a light cap face (spec bans bright discs); the prompt now pins an asphalt-black face with an orange crackle rim.

frames.lore_anchor: Every summer the block throws a party on power borrowed from a streetlamp; chips started here as literal battle-winner tokens.

hook.ru: The lamp is still paying for that party.
hook.en: The lamp is still paying for that party.

beats: 0.0–2.0 s — acid-yellow lamp cuts the drizzle above the crowd, cable coils down the pole
2.0–5.5 s — the breaker hits the peak of the windmill on flattened cardboard; the cap spins under him
5.5–9.0 s — freeze, crowd silhouettes, hook text
frames.sfx: kick + breakbeat, bass through a speaker grille rattle, crowd noise, chain-link clink
frames.caption_ru: Каждое лето квартал устраивает вечеринку на свете, украденном у фонаря. Никто не считает это преступлением — это традиция. Район 05 · Бумбокс-Квартал.
frames.caption_en: Every summer the block runs a party off power borrowed from a street lamp. Nobody calls that a crime — they call it tradition. District 05 · Boombox Block.

frames.lore_anchor: The hidden animal kingdom under the city: a one-eyed cat running a block, a pigeon flock that votes on rooftops, raccoons hitting dumpsters with military timing — spirits of the street, never villains.

hook.ru: Under the city, someone else is running the block.
hook.en: Under the city, someone else runs the block.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — steam from the open manhole, string lights, wet cobbles, cyan puddles
2.5–6.0 s — the heist plays out: bag out of the dumpster, the runner, the lookout on the lid
6.0–9.0 s — the lookout turns and looks straight at the camera, cyan eye-shine, hook text
frames.sfx: dripping pipes, bin lid clang, clawed paws on wet stone, a single pigeon coo
frames.caption_ru: В городе всегда рассказывали про звериное королевство под ним: одноглазый кот, голубиное голосование на крышах, еноты с военной точностью. Они не злодеи — просто духи улиц. Район 06 · Звери Ливнёвки.
frames.caption_en: The city always told stories about the kingdom underneath it: raccoons on military timing, a cat running a block. Not villains — street spirits. District 06 · Gutter Beasts.

frames.lore_anchor: When the real arcades shut down the cabinets got rebuilt in basements nobody advertises; the games are half-broken and half-invented, and the door to a level nobody was supposed to find is the district's Epic.

hook.ru: There is a level nobody was supposed to find.
hook.en: There's a level nobody was supposed to find.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — dripping tunnel, dead cabinets, one CRT still warm
2.5–6.0 s — push through to the steel door bleeding magenta light; cables and cold vapour in the gap
6.0–9.0 s — the cap on the control panel, oil-slick steel rim, hook text
frames.sfx: CRT whine, coin drop, distant arcade chiptune, electrical crackle from the doorway
frames.caption_ru: Под городом есть подвал, о котором не пишут. Дверь приоткрыта, оттуда тянет холодом и светом — это уровень, который никто не должен был найти. Район 07 · Пиксельный Подвал.
frames.caption_en: Under the city there's a basement nobody advertises. The door is ajar and the light is magenta — a level nobody was supposed to find. District 07 · Pixel Basement.

frames.lore_anchor: The meta-collection: the folklore of the other seven districts written down — the rumours about Moth, the arguments about the Invisible Car — and its Diamond chip closes the loop back to Collection 01.

hook.ru: Every legend starts as a rumour nobody wrote down.
hook.en: Every legend starts as a rumour nobody wrote down.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — storm over the skyline, lightning, wet parapet, torn paper scraps skating in the wind
2.5–6.0 s — the hooded writer at the parapet, can in hand, crows watching; the cap rises over the city with a holo rim
6.0–9.0 s — the prism rim scatters rainbow facets across the rooftops, hook text
frames.sfx: wind over a rooftop, far thunder, spray hiss, paper flapping, crows
frames.caption_ru: Здесь записывают слухи всех семи районов: про Мотылька, про Невидимый Вагон, про то, что живёт под городом. Последняя фишка серии замыкает круг на первый район. Район 10 · Городские Мифы.
frames.caption_en: This is where the rumours about all seven districts get written down — and the Diamond closes the loop straight back to District 01. District 10 · City Myths.

frames.lore_anchor: 3 → 1 fusion, eight recipes: cross-district 'recharge' and same-district 'new story'. The chips orbiting the bench are the real district faces (moth, wheel, freight car).
beats: 0.0–2.0 s — the bench, magnet wall, arcs snapping between the coils
2.0–5.5 s — three caps spiral in, the new cap forms white-hot in the ring of sparks
5.5–9.0 s — the fused cap lands, paint drips upward, hook text + «3 → 1»
frames.sfx: induction coil whine, metal shriek, welding arc snaps, a satisfying clack on the landing
frames.caption_ru: Три фишки — одна новая история. Кросс-районный «перезаряд» или продолжение в своём районе: сгоревший металл никуда не пропадает. Механика фьюжна.
frames.caption_en: Three caps, one new story — cross-district recharge or a same-district sequel. The mechanic: 3 → 1 fusion.

frames.lore_anchor: Cap Slam: 3v3 squads, best-of-3, five district elements in a ring (paint > steel > wheels > noise > shadow), rewards paid in $CG.

hook.ru: Squad of three. Best of three. Payout on-chain.
hook.en: Squad of three. Best of three. Paid on-chain.

beats: 0.0–2.5 s — floodlights, containers, the crowd's phone lights, chalk lanes on wet asphalt
2.5–6.0 s — 3 vs 3 collision: shockwave ring of droplets and sparks, elemental glyphs burning in the puddles
6.0–9.0 s — the impact holds, everything freezes for half a second, hook text + «3v3»
frames.sfx: crowd roar, metal impact with a deep thud, arcane crackle on the glyphs, slow-motion reverb on the freeze
frames.caption_ru: Отряд из трёх, до двух побед, награда в $CG. Пять стихий районов по кругу — и подписанный сид, который потом можно проверить. Режим Cap Slam.
frames.caption_en: A squad of three, best-of-three, paid in $CG — five district elements in a ring and a published seed you can verify later. Cap Slam.
